from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 66.3
thickness = 13.3
tab_width = 15.6
tab_height = 15.6
hole_diameter = 3.9
hole_radius = 22.15

base = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(outer_diameter / 2, thickness)
tab = Pos(0, 0, outer_diameter / 2 + tab_height / 2) * Box(tab_width, thickness, tab_height)
result = base + tab

for i in range(8):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / 8)
    px = hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    pz = hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    result = result - Pos(px, 0, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, thickness + 2)

part = result
part.name = "disc_with_tab_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
